# Prepared TLS credential owner controls

Run `run-controls.sh` in the declared dev shell, with exact NODE26_REFERENCE,
NODE26_SOURCE and a fresh TLS_CREDENTIALS_CONTROL_DIR. No product/global setup
or guest/library/engine build is performed. The current node-core.js must have
been regenerated by normal build.py first.

These controls compile the actual generated credential algorithms over native
Node 26.13.0 OpenSSL/ncrypto exports. They invoke the unchanged curated production
TLS forwarder and pinned JS configuration selections. Compare actual certificate
and issuer DER and exact error fields against native createSecureContext. This
is a component transport seam; production never calls native host node:tls.

Additional controls perform actual local OpenSSL memory-BIO mutual-auth TLS
handshakes and encrypted record transfer after the original context wrapper is
collected while an independent SSL_CTX reference survives. Missing credentials
and wrong trust fail real handshakes. Failed admissions do not retain additional
native owners. This establishes neither guest transport nor SpiderMonkey GC.

The guest dependency and native component are distinct artifacts/configurations,
even though both currently pin3.5.9. Full public SecureContext/server/configuration,
engine compilation and Node/Chromium/Firefox/WebKit guest conformance remain open.
